checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same sneaker, original side view, fully inside frame
must.why: Same pose, position and shape; fully in frame.
Laces, stitching, heel tab, sole dots preserved.

must.item: Grey floor and clutter replaced by seamless white
must.why: Background is white with faint grey vignette near edges, no clutter.

must.item: Soft shadow without visible floor boundary
must.why: Soft grey shadow under sole; no hard floor line, though somewhat dark at the ends.
Wide, same shape as the original (about 640x384); no text.

faults.what: Faint grey gradient/vignette at the edges so the white is not perfectly pure.
Shadow is a bit heavy and dark at the heel and toe ends.
Slight redraw of the shoe collar/interior, though close to the original.

summary: A clean white-background product shot that keeps the sneaker faithful to the original, with a soft grounding shadow and only minor edge vignetting and shadow heaviness.
